R7BJ-bear-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2015 (fire G90175), 130 m SW: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 70 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
